attchmntText: MSP Steel & Power Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
MSP Steel & Power Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: MSP Steel and Power Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a net profit of 3,446.90 INR Crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and 5,643.42 INR Crore for the half-year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations stood at 80,698.50 INR Crore for the quarter. The board appointed Mr. Asit Kumar Kayal, DIN 11160539, as an Additional Director, Non-Executive Non-Independent Director, effective November 13, 2026, subject to shareholder approval. Mr. Pradip Kumar Dey, DIN 00587842, resigned as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director effective November 13, 2026. Board committees were reconstituted effective November 13, 2026. The company confirmed no defaults on loans and debt securities.
